name: branding-xvect-wordmark-with-swoosh-x-on-cyan-gradient
title: 'Xvect' white wordmark with a curling swoosh on the X, on a cyan-blue gradient tile
whatItIs: A square tile with a cyan-to-blue gradient and a white lowercase 'Xvect' wordmark whose oversized X extends into a curved swoosh with a small hook, like a vector or arrow path.
whatItMeans: Light and techy; the swoosh hints at motion and vectors while staying simple.
techniques: Enlarge the first letter and give it a single signature stroke.
Set a white mark on a two-tone gradient tile.
Keep the rest of the word plain so the flourish stands out.

vocabulary.definition: A decorative extended stroke on a letter.
A logo made purely of the brand name.
